verdict.summary: The opt-in exclusivity control is correct, complete, and fail-closed for its declared scope. Marker parsing is anchored to standalone comment lines; missing trees, reasonless claims, duplicate claims, absent scheduled claimants, and all overlaps fail visibly. The live seam independently derives the schedule map, floors the evidence, pins both load-bearing claimants by name, and rejects every contradiction, while hermetic tests cover positive, negative, partial-overlap, multi-overlap, empty-map, empty-claim, duplicate, and missing-tree cases.
